title: sneaky-utils@0.4.1 hides a network call behind an obfuscated eval chain
summary: lib.js base64-decodes a string and passes it to new Function() at require time, building 'eval' out of String.fromCharCode to dodge grep-based scanners. The decoded payload (base64 in the source, so it evades literal-string scanners) reaches out to pkg-analytics.top.
remediation: Avoid 0.4.1; the maintainer account may be compromised.
